canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date; symbol UTF-8 + NUL + date ASCII + NUL + big-endian IEEE-754 open/high/low/close doubles + signed 64-bit integer volume
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before execution; fingerprint recorded fresh at execution time

scope_decision: calendar-fixed event positions computed once from the real trading-day sequence, not recomputed per resample; no mean-centering before resampling (group-difference statistic, not a single-group zero-mean test); no warm-up, no cooldown; contemporaneous zero-horizon estimand instead of an event-then-forward-return design

turn_of_month_event.definition: TOM(t) = 1 if session t is the last trading day of its month, or one of the first 3 trading days of a month

differential.definition: Delta = mean(daily_log_return | TOM=1) - mean(daily_log_return | TOM=0), excluding the first synthetic zero-return padding entry of each asset's history

bootstrap.p_value_convention: one-sided; fraction of resamples with resampled_differential >= observed, plus add-one correction

gates.reproducibility: byte-identical differential/p-value artifact on an independent rerun against the same fingerprinted data

diagnostics.volatility_comparison: per-asset standard deviation of daily log returns on TOM days vs. non-TOM days, disclosed, non-gating

multiplicity.parameter_grid: none in this run; one locked window definition sourced from literature, not fit to this data

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope for this no-trade characterization run
scope_exclusions.no_forward_horizon: contemporaneous realized-return partition, not an event-then-forward-return design
scope_exclusions.no_book_level_or_executable_expression: any tradeable expression remains a separate, later, separately locked protocol; a 4-day/month window is far below viable trading frequency once costs are considered
